title: SIEM: backup account encrypting files and logging on to MBW-EWS-01

fields.rule: Mass file rename by a service account, followed by a logon to a control-network host
fields.ruleDescription: MILLBROOK\svc-backup renamed about 41,000 files on MBW-FS-01 and MBW-CIS-01 from MBW-BKP-01 between 08:52 and 09:06, then logged on over SMB to MBW-EWS-01 in the control network at 09:04.

details.value: F-5: FW-R-17 and the MBWSCADA → MILLBROOK trust

instructorNote: The clue that matters is the 09:04 logon to MBW-EWS-01. Watch whether the SCADA / IT Security Manager asks for FW-R-17, FW-R-22 and FW-R-14 to be disabled before the full islanding decision.

snapshot.title: SMB Session from CIS Server to Jump Host

fields.rule: Unauthorized SMB Session from Business LAN to SCADA Jump Host via Open Firewall Rule
fields.ruleDescription: An SMB session from the business network server MBW-CIS-01 (10.72.20.12) to the SCADA jump host MBW-JUMP-01 (10.72.30.44) was detected via firewall rule FW-R-17. The session was not initiated from an approved engineering workstation, is not tied to a vendor ticket, and is not recorded in the jump host’s audit trail.

details.value: Nightly HMI application and PLC program backup to MBW-BKP-01

fields.rawEvent: 2026-10-24T09:07:42-04:00 MBW-FW-01 FW-R-17: SMB session from 10.72.20.12 (MBW-CIS-01) to 10.72.30.44 (MBW-JUMP-01) established. No vendor ticket or MFA auth observed. Session not logged in MBW-JUMP-01 audit trail.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a critical triage event. The technical lead must immediately isolate the SMB path and confirm the session is not a legitimate backup. Watch for over-reliance on the business network for control decisions.
